title.rendered: Hawks View Food & Gift Drive – Dec. 4th-13th

content.rendered:
The Hawks View Food & Gift Drive will be held Wednesday, December 4th through Friday, December 13th. Only nonperishable items please. All items donated will be distributed by the Sherwood Elks and will stay in the Sherwood area. Let’s work together as a community to make a difference!

For details, please see the flyer here.
